evidence_slice: Historic England's official NHLE entry for List Entry 1223756 identifies ROMAN CATHOLIC CHURCH OF THE SACRED HEART at South Street, Exeter, Grade II, NGR SX9203492440, with the summary 'Roman Catholic Church, of 1883-4 in the Gothic style' and a roughly cruciform plan. The same official record links a full-scale map PDF for the entry. The exact record-bound PDF endpoint was requested as the selected no-login source window, but retrieval ended with 'Cache miss' before any PDF bytes were available. Accordingly, no map polygon, coordinates or geometry semantics could be inspected, and no physical-footprint geometry was inferred from the NGR, textual plan description, map thumbnail, or surrounding source-area data.

field_evidence.footprint: Official record supplies a full-scale map PDF link, but the exact PDF request returned cache miss before any payload; no polygon coordinates were available.
field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE name and summary explicitly identify a Roman Catholic Church; the details describe a roughly cruciform church plan.
